LanguageData.EF_Alert_WrongBloodlineDesc:
These pawns are using entads bound to another bloodline. The items work as ordinary items, but their entad traits do nothing for them:
{0}
LanguageData.EF_Card_BoundDesc: This entad is bound. Anyone can use it as an ordinary item, but its traits only work for the pawns it is bound to and their descendants. Its durability, value and effects on a building apply regardless.
LanguageData.EF_Card_InactiveFor: Its traits do nothing for {0}, who is not of a bound bloodline.
LanguageData.EF_Card_IgnoresAccuracyMaluses: Ignores weather, smoke and other accuracy penalties
LanguageData.EF_Card_Persona: Bonds to the first person who equips it. Nobody else can wield it until they die.
LanguageData.EF_Card_Secretive: Keeps its other traits secret until they show themselves.
LanguageData.EF_Card_NeverBond: Never bonds: anyone can wield it.
LanguageData.EF_Card_OtherWeaponThought: When the bonded person wields another weapon: {0} ({1} mood)
LanguageData.EF_Card_KillThirst: After {0} days without a kill: {1} ({2} mood)
LanguageData.EF_Persona_EquipWarning: {0} has a persona. Once it bonds to a wielder, it will refuse to be wielded by anyone else.
LanguageData.EF_Persona_EquipConfirm: Are you sure you want to equip it?
LanguageData.EF_Stat_DamageTypeDesc: {0}: this weapon's attacks deal {1} damage instead of their usual type.
LanguageData.EF_Stat_ExtraDamageDesc: {0}: each hit deals this much additional {1} damage, on top of the weapon's normal damage. It is not reduced by or added to the Damage stat above.
LanguageData.EF_Stat_IgnoresAccuracyMalusesDesc: {0}: shots from this weapon ignore the accuracy and range penalties from weather and from blind smoke.
LanguageData.EF_Stat_ExtraTotalDesc: Total additional damage, of other damage types, dealt with every hit by this weapon's entad traits.
LanguageData.EF_AbilityUnknown: The effect of this ability is not yet known.
LanguageData.EF_Settings_Reset_Tip: Resets the General and Rarity and durability tabs. Which traits are enabled is left as it is.
LanguageData.EF_Settings_HideTraits_Tip: Newly generated entad items show "???" for their traits until something the trait affects happens. Existing items keep their current state.
LanguageData.EF_Settings_WeaponWeight_Desc: How much more likely traits made for weapons (damage, accuracy, ...) are than general ones when generating for a weapon. 1 = no preference.
LanguageData.EF_Settings_UniqueChance: Unique and persona weapons get entad traits: {0}
LanguageData.EF_Settings_UniqueChance_Desc: Chance that a vanilla unique or persona weapon gets random entad traits when it's picked for them. These weapons already have their own weapon traits. Traits added by name are not affected.
LanguageData.EF_Settings_RarityCurve_Desc: Relative chance of each rarity when a trait is picked. Rarities with no eligible trait are skipped and the rest are renormalised.
LanguageData.EF_Settings_Multipliers_Desc: How much a rarity widens the min/max of traits that scale with rarity. Offsets are multiplied; factors scale their distance from 100%. A trait is capped at the highest rarity where its values stay valid (for example a factor never drops to zero).
LanguageData.EF_Settings_Durability_Desc: Max hit points multiplier for every item with at least one entad trait, set by the highest rarity among its traits.
LanguageData.EF_Settings_Points_Desc: What a trait at each rarity costs from an item's point budget, when the trait doesn't set its own value. A trait that scales with rarity has its cost multiplied by the same ratio between its own rarity and the rolled one.
LanguageData.EF_Settings_PointTarget_Desc: Traits are picked until the item reaches its target, and the last trait can go over it. A bigger target gives more traits and opens up rarer ones. Used when the mod generating the item doesn't set its own target.
LanguageData.EF_Settings_Overshoot_Desc: How strongly traits that would take an item well past its target are held back. At 0 the target is only a minimum and rare traits turn up on cheap items as often as anywhere. At 1, a Legendary trait shows up on roughly 1 in 100 items with a target of 2. Higher values keep items closer to their target.
LanguageData.EF_Settings_DrawbackChance: Chance an item can have drawbacks: {0}
LanguageData.EF_Settings_Drawbacks_Desc: Drawbacks are traits with a cost below zero. Each one adds its points back to the target, so the item gets more or better traits to make up for it.
LanguageData.EF_Settings_TraitCounts: {0} of {1} traits shown, {2} disabled. Disabled traits are never picked when generating items.
